T: You're killing me, Smalls. Have a s'more.
D: A new kid in town joins a neighbourhood baseball team for one unforgettable summer.
P: Serve the s'mores when Ham explains them to Smalls in the treehouse.
S: Ham can't believe Smalls has never had one
Big marshmallows toasted over a flame until blistered and molten, sandwiched with a square of milk chocolate between two digestive biscuits, pressed so the chocolate melts.
a sandlot game in the summer heat

Peanuts in the shell roasted, then tossed in a sticky honey and butter glaze with sea salt and a little smoked paprika, served in paper bags. Spread 400g raw peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 15 minutes. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 1 tsp sea salt and half a tsp smoked paprika. Toss the hot peanuts through the glaze, spread back on the tray and roast 6 minutes more until sticky. Cool so the glaze sets, then divide into four paper bags with a bowl for the shells.
the day at the pool with the lifeguard

Fresh watermelon blended with lime and a little sugar, frozen in moulds with whole raspberries, then dipped in a little sour lime sugar. Blend 800g seedless watermelon with the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp caster sugar, then strain. Drop 3 raspberries into each of 8 ice block moulds and pour in the juice. Freeze for 1 hour, push in sticks and freeze 5 hours more. Mix 2 tbsp caster sugar with the zest of 1 lime. Unmould and dip the tips in the lime sugar to serve.
M: the night game under the fireworks
Franks scored and grilled over coals until blistered, in toasted buns with mustard, sweet relish and onions cooked slowly in butter.
a summer of baseball and backyard grills

Two thin chuck patties smashed on a hot grill, cheddar melted over, stacked with pickles, onion and burger sauce in a soft bun, with buttered corn. Roll 800g chuck mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 2 tbsp chopped pickles for sauce. Heat a hotplate to very hot, smash the balls flat, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and lay a slice of cheddar on each. Stack two per toasted bun with lettuce, onion, pickles and sauce. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and roll in butter and salt.
W: Carnival fairy floss and toffee apples
the carnival where the rides go badly
Sugar, water and golden syrup boiled to 150C, red colouring, apples on sticks dipped and twirled, set on oiled paper. Bought fairy floss alongside.
K: a hot summer on the sandlot

Fresh lemon juice stirred with strawberry syrup and cold soda water, poured over ice with lemon wheels and sliced strawberries. Simmer 250g hulled strawberries with 150g caster sugar and 150ml water for 5 minutes, mash and strain, then cool the syrup. Squeeze 5 lemons. In a big jug mix the syrup, lemon juice and 1L cold soda water. Add lemon wheels, a few sliced strawberries and plenty of ice. Stir well and pour.

m.note: the night game under the fireworks
m.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in 30g butter for 20 minutes. Score 8 franks and grill over coals until blistered. Toast 8 buns and fill with franks, onions, mustard and sweet relish.

w.n: Carnival fairy floss and toffee apples
w.note: the carnival where the rides go badly
w.how: Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 2 tbsp golden syrup to 150C, add red colouring and dip and twirl the apples. Set on oiled paper and serve with a bag of fairy floss.
